query:
UPDATE alert_channels
        SET name = $3, kind = $4, config = $5, active = $6,
            signing_secret = CASE
                WHEN $4 <> 'webhook' THEN NULL
                WHEN kind = 'webhook' THEN signing_secret
                ELSE $7
            END
        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2
        RETURNING coalesce(signing_secret = $7, false) AS "generated!"
